tower_vitality.description: Tower of Vitality: tower of elem_vitality. Rule 2: the tile turns face up (open) once a unit attacks or moves towards it; effects lying there fire once as traps with 20 power per element. A character standing on it with stat_vitality ≥ 20, or adept in elem_vitality, gains +4 to that stat (yields.stat_bonus). Visiting one's tower also lifts the Love / Awe / Anger / Fear permanents (effects say "until they visit their tower"). In-contact units may attack or move onto it (Rule 7).

prerequisites.description: Rule 2: a unit in contact (distance ≤ 1) opens the tile by attacking or moving towards it.
To use the tower the character must stand on it (distance 0).
requirement: the stat behind elem_vitality (stat_of) is at least 20, or (or_adept) the character's adept element is this tower's element (caster.adept_element assumed in context).

effects.description: yields.stat_bonus added to the tower's stat while the tower is held.

The caster's stat behind the tower element (what the requirement compares).

item_library.description: Dimension Library: the starting location of a dimension (tags spawn). Rule 2: the tile turns face up (open) once a unit attacks or moves towards it; effects lying there fire once as traps with 20 power per element. mine_vit_wat_har.description: Mine (Vit + Water + Harmony): a mine that yields 15 gold per turn once its three element permanents (elem_vitality, elem_water, elem_harmony) are held on it. Rule 2: the tile turns face up (open) once a unit attacks or moves towards it; effects lying there fire once as traps with 20 power per element. The owner must hold tokens of each required element (duplicates such as elem_vitality twice are counted by multiplicity in the paper; subset_of here checks presence). Mines are deck cards in the MMORPG modes (mode_mmorpg starting composition: 2 mines).
